results.text: Review of acarbose therapeutic strategies in the long-term treatment and in the prevention of type 2 diabetes. Acarbose--the most extensively investigated and widely prescribed alpha-glucosidase inhibitor--reduces postprandial plasma glucose excursions by delaying the absorption of carbohydrate from the small intestine.
